title: Conversation list
description: GET /v1/conversations: one page of the user's conversations, newest activity first. Each conversation is the Conversation of openapi.yaml (components/schemas/Conversation); this schema checks the page around them.

next_cursor.description: Passed as cursor for the next page; null on the last one.

resume_conversation_id.description: The conversation POST /conversations would answer instead of starting a new one, while config.conversation.single is true (SDK 1.0.7). Every way of starting a new conversation (the send card, the new conversation button in the list, Clomni.present) opens this one with its history; null: a new conversation as usual. The server decides which conversation it is, and the SDK applies no rule of its own: it need not be on this page, so the SDK opens it by id (GET /conversations/{id}). The same on every page of one listing. Absent (a server before SDK 1.0.7) means null.
